title: Berry Betrayal — Episode 1
logline: In the juicy world of jam trade, ambitious strawberry, Rico, discovers a shocking betrayal that could ruin the cartel. Will his sweet revenge keep him fresh?

captions.en: I've just discovered that the seeds of betrayal lie within our own berries!
captions.fr: Je viens de découvrir que les graines de trahison sont parmi nos propres baies!
captions.es: ¡Acabo de descubrir que las semillas de traición están entre nuestras propias bayas!

captions.en: Rico, sweetie, you were never supposed to find out!
captions.fr: Rico, chéri, tu n'étais jamais censé le découvrir!
